up: Retrieve the IC50 activities of the compound tylophorine (CHEMBL493620) and all its salt forms (i.e., any molecules that are direct children in the molecule_hierarchy table with parent_molregno equal to the molregno of CHEMBL493620, including the parent itself) tested against the target with CHEMBL ID CHEMBL3879801. For each activity, return the compound's ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), preferred name, canonical SMILES (from compound_structures), the IC50 activity value (standard_value), standard_units, standard_relation, pchembl_value, and the literature reference details: pubmed_id, doi, journal, and year from the docs table. Include all available IC50 measurements without any additional filters on units or relation; do not limit the number of rows.
sql: WITH parent_molregno AS (SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL493620'), all_molregno AS (SELECT molregno FROM molecule_hierarchy WHERE parent_molregno = (SELECT molregno FROM parent_molregno) UNION SELECT molregno FROM parent_molregno) SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation, a.pchembl_value, d.pubmed_id, d.doi, d.journal, d.year FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.molregno IN (SELECT molregno FROM all_molregno) AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3879801';
